newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian rupee steady, seen gaining vs forward dlr.
newsitem.headline: Indian rupee steady, seen gaining vs forward dlr.

text.p: * The Indian rupee opens at 35.82/83 against the dollar on Thursday, compared to the previous close of 35.81/82, and seen unaffected by central bank's lending rate cut, dealers say.
* The rupee quickly reverts to 35.81/82 after opening.
* Forward premiums seen falling sharply on Wednesday's bank rate cut and an expected fall in bank's lending rates.
* Spot dollar seen unaffected by the bank rate cut.
* The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) seen defending the dollar at 35.81/82 rupees to a dollar.
* Dealers look towards east for signs of month-end spurt in dollar demand from the State Bank of India (SBI).
